profile.headline: Software Engineer @ PlayStation, Sony Interactive Entertainment
profile.summary: I am currently a Software Engineer at PlayStation. I have a background in Data Science and Machine Learning, as well as years of coding experience in Python, Java, and others. I've always had a passion for programming, building things, and problem-solving, and I love finding new challenges to overcome. Message, email, or connect with me for my resume.

positions.title: Data Scientist
positions.description:
• Performed PCA (principle component analysis) and regression techniques in R to create a new model for space vehicle schedules that performed better than the existing model
• Cleaned, explored, analyzed, and visualized satellite data with R and Python, using statistical techniques such as data transformations, t-testing, data normalization, and many others
• Updated and debugged our online data science and machine learning platform, creating tools for multivariate exploration such as interactive correlation/scatterplot matrices, density-based clustering, as well as various app improvements
• Researched data from Department of Defense contractors in order to analyze satellite schedule patterns and drivers

positions.title: Data Analyst
positions.description:
• Built and implemented SQL reporting for Business Banking growth and production to efficiently track over $240 million in flux
• Worked closely with Director of Business Banking & Home Loans to automate reports and create models, providing in-depth insight while also saving many hours of manual preparation before meetings
• Worked cross-functionally with other departments to summarize KPI metrics and calculate business manager incentives to ensure that teams were on track with quarterly goals

positions.title: Business Support Manager (Xchange Leasing)
positions.description:
• Created KPI dashboards for 10+ teams, which made them more effective in accurately tracking workflow/performance
• Used R to explore and analyze patterns in vehicle activity to identify marketing opportunities as well as potential issues
• Validated company-wide data migration using SQL by detecting discrepancies, duplicates, missing data
• Built ad-hoc and control reports in SQL to ensure regulatory compliance and quality within the teams

positions.title: Data Analyst/Insurance Specialist (Xchange Leasing)
positions.description:
• Worked directly with Senior Managers to provided invaluable data insights, ad hoc reports, and provided useful analysis and research 
• Used Python, R, and SQL to analyze large data-sets as well as automate reports
• Integrated new methods of reporting using MAQL and SQL, building over 220 reports to allow managers insight to workflow development
• Working partly as an Insurance Specialist to construct and solidify insurance processes starting from the ground up
• Managed data clean-up processes in R as well as advanced Excel (v-lookup, pivot tables, macros, conditional functions, etc.)
• Presented to senior leadership, showcasing projects worked on beyond the scope of my duties; promoted to managerial position soon after

positions.title: Aerospace Scholars Program
positions.description: Participate in an aerospace course over several weeks and accepted to NASA summer program thereafter. Led a team of other interns in designing and analyzing machine prototypes that would be viable in space. Presented results and relevant findings to NASA program managers.

company.name: NASA - National Aeronautics and Space Administration

organizations.name: Alpha Kappa Psi Professional Business Fraternity
organizations.description: Alpha Kappa Psi is the nation's oldest and largest business fraternity. The Omicron Omega chapter at the University of California, Santa Barbara was established in 1998, and since then has been a symbol of excellence among university students in academic, professional, and entrepreneurial circles.
